zh.page_title: LiveCopilot — 实时对话中的 AI 助手
zh.description: 为线上面试、答辩和会议设计的 AI 实时提示器。 听取对话，结合你提前导入的简历、文档和个人资料，快速找回重点、组织回答。

zh.p_input: 输入问题，无需开启监听
zh.tr_title:
对方说的每一句，
都实时变成文字。
zh.tr_body: 同时听取麦克风和系统音频，远程会议时分别标出“我”和“对方”。转写默认折叠成三行并跟随最新一句，把空间留给回答；点“展开转写”即可回看。
zh.tr_caption: 真实悬浮窗局部 · 示例内容 · 可点“展开转写”
zh.tr_pop_note: 使用已配置的回答模型。开启后会向该服务发送最近一句及后续稳定的临时转写文字，并消耗 API 用量。保留原文；服务较慢时仅处理最近 20 条转写。
zh.tr_l1: Let's start with the Q3 numbers.
zh.tr_l1_tr: 我们先从第三季度的数据说起。
zh.tr_l2: Retention is up, but onboarding is still slow.
zh.tr_l2_tr: 留存提升了，但新用户上手仍然偏慢。
zh.tr_l3: What would you ship first, and why?
zh.tr_l3_tr: 你会先上线什么？为什么？
zh.workflow_question: 如果只能先上线一个功能，你会怎么判断优先级？
zh.workflow_answer: 我会先看三个因素：用户价值、实现成本，以及它是不是后续能力的基础。
zh.answer_caption: 真实界面局部 · 示例内容 · 可展开依据与来源
zh.edge_visible_note: 窗口停靠右侧；隐藏后没有常驻把手
zh.edge_hidden_note: 窗口已隐藏 · 鼠标移到右侧边缘即可唤回
zh.f_history_body: 转写、回答和来源保存在本机，可按日期浏览和搜索。
zh.history_item1: 产品评审 · 优先级讨论
zh.cases_note: 示例资料与回答均为虚构内容；网页不调用 AI。
zh.privacy_intro: 没有 LiveCopilot 账号，也没有开发者中转服务器。资料、索引和会话历史保存在本机；生成回答时，只把当前问题、相关对话和检索到的片段发送给你选择的 AI 服务。
zh.install_intro: 下载后连接你的回答服务即可开始，需要时再导入简历或文档。
zh.ans_title:
从你的资料里，
整理出说得出口的回答。
zh.ans_intro: 回答会写成可以直接说出口的话，并附上依据和来源。按场合选择是否只依据你的资料；不导入资料也能回答通用问题，还可以一键总结对话或生成追问。
zh.style_example: 用短句回答，并解释专业术语。先给结论，再分点说明。
zh.style_hint: 每次请求会随问题发送给分析服务
zh.pairs_zh1: 我会先上线新用户引导。
zh.pairs_en1: I would ship the new onboarding flow first.
zh.pairs_zh2: 它直接影响留存，也是后续功能的基础。
zh.pairs_en2: It drives retention and supports later features.
zh.ov_title:
需要时在场，
其余时候，留给对话。
zh.ov_intro: 默认停靠在屏幕右侧，鼠标移到边缘时展开，⌥H 随时唤出；固定后可拖到任意位置。共享屏幕时隐藏为可选设置，默认关闭，请先在会议软件中测试。
zh.svc_title:
每一步用什么服务，
由你决定。
zh.svc_lead: 语音识别、资料索引和回答生成分别选择。能在本机完成的可以留在本机，回答由你选择的云端服务生成。
zh.svc_speech_body: 前三种在本机识别，Apple Speech 需要 macOS 26+；GPT-Live-1 会把音频发给 OpenAI，按连接时长计费。自动判断何时回答：本地语音可搭配 Laya（仅 Apple Silicon，模型另行下载），GPT-Live-1 由模型按语义判断。两者都可能漏判，随时可以手动生成。
zh.svc_index_body: BGE-M3 在本机生成向量；OpenAI Embeddings 无需下载本地模型，但文档和查询文本会发给 OpenAI。两种方式的检索数据库都保存在本机。
zh.svc_answer_body: 必须配置，需要你自己的 API Key，由服务商按用量计费。每次回答会发送问题、相关对话和检索片段；思考越深，通常等待越久。
zh.tr_note: 可选，默认关闭。在悬浮窗点“翻译”选择目标语言，译文显示在原文下方；翻译使用你的回答服务，会产生 API 用量。
zh.custom_body: 在设置里写下偏好，比如用短句、解释术语、先给结论。需要用英文作答时，可以开启中英逐句对照，每句中文后紧接英文；它作用于你的回答，与翻译对方说话的转写翻译不同。
zh.service_guide_link: 服务指南：模型、价格与端点（英文）
zh.passage_found: 已找到 3 个相关片段
zh.privacy_boundary: 选择云端语音或向量服务时，相应的音频或资料文本也会发给该服务；开启转写翻译时，转写文字会发给回答服务。服务商自己的数据政策仍然适用，删除本地历史也无法撤回已发出的请求。检查更新时会读取本网站上的更新信息。
zh.privacy_keychain: API 密钥存入 macOS 钥匙串
zh.privacy_route_provider: 你选择的 AI 服务
zh.wf_title:
从听见问题，
到组织好回答。
zh.wf_intro: 三个环节依次衔接。开启自动建议时，对方问完就开始准备回答；也可以随时手动提问。
zh.wf_hear: 麦克风和系统音频实时转为文字，并判断问题是否已经说完。
zh.wf_find: 在本机资料库里找回相关片段；不导入资料也能直接回答。
zh.wf_answer: 交给你选择的回答服务，写成可以说出口的话，并附上来源。
zh.wf_note: 示例内容；网页不录音，也不调用 AI。
zh.eng_zip: 可选术语增强（默认关闭）。模型约 200 MB，首次使用时下载。
zh.eng_apple: 开始前选定一种语言，不会自动切换。使用 macOS 自带的语音模型，需要 macOS 26+。
zh.eng_live_lang: 中文优先、英文优先、中英混合或不限语言
zh.eng_live: 语言设置只是提示，不会强制锁定；能按语义判断何时需要回答。音频发给 OpenAI，按连接时长计费。
zh.eng_note: 另可选本地 Paraformer（中英双语）。远程会议分别标出“我”和“对方”；现场模式统一标为“现场”，不区分在场的不同说话人。
zh.mode_general_body: 不查资料，用通用知识回答。
zh.mode_hybrid_body: 问题需要时才引用你的资料，其余用通用知识。
zh.mode_kb_body: 只依据你的资料；找不到依据时会说明缺口。
zh.eng_note_laya: 本地语音搭配 Laya 也能自动判断何时回答，Laya 仅支持 Apple Silicon。
zh.mode_general_answer: 一般可以看三点：用户价值、实现成本，以及它是不是后续功能的基础。先上线价值高、成本可控的那一个。
zh.mode_kb_answer: 按产品策略，优先解决高频用户问题；路线图也把基础能力排在扩展之前。所以我会先上线最高频、又能为后续打基础的功能。

en.page_title: LiveCopilot — AI for the conversation in front of you
en.description: A real-time AI copilot for online interviews, defenses, and meetings. LiveCopilot follows the conversation and draws from the resume, documents, and personal materials you've prepared to surface what matters and help you shape your response.
en.credit_prefix: Built on the native macOS foundation of
en.site_privacy: This site uses no analytics, external fonts, or cookies.
en.workflow_evidence_text: The strategy highlights frequent user needs; the Roadmap puts core capabilities ahead of later expansion. [S1][S2]
en.cases_title:
Different conversations.
The same prepared you.
en.privacy_title: Your materials can stay on your Mac.
en.install_title:
Your next conversation.
A little more composed.
en.hero_subtitle_phrases: LiveCopilot hears the conversation, brings in your own material, and helps you find words to respond, right on your Mac.
en.hero_cost_phrases: Free and open source. Answers use your own AI provider API key and are billed by that provider.
en.demo_note_more: A web simulation: nothing is recorded and no AI service is called. Text is slightly larger than in the app for legibility.
en.product_label: Interactive demo of the LiveCopilot 2.7 overlay
en.p_input: Ask anything — listening can be off
en.tr_title:
Every word they say,
as text in real time.
en.tr_body: LiveCopilot listens to your microphone and system audio, labelling You and Them in remote meetings. The transcript folds to three lines and follows the latest one, leaving room for answers; choose Expand transcript to look back.
en.tr_caption: Real overlay excerpt · sample content · try Expand transcript
en.tr_pop_note: Uses your configured answer model. Enabling sends the latest utterance and subsequent stable transcript previews to that service and uses its API quota. Original text is retained. A slow service only processes the latest 20 lines.
en.tr_l1: 我们先从第三季度的数据说起。
en.tr_l1_tr: Let's start with the Q3 numbers.
en.tr_l2: 留存提升了，但新用户上手仍然偏慢。
en.tr_l2_tr: Retention is up, but onboarding is still slow.
en.tr_l3: 你会先上线什么？为什么？
en.tr_l3_tr: What would you ship first, and why?
en.workflow_question: If you could ship only one feature first, how would you prioritize?
en.workflow_answer: I'd weigh three things: user value, cost to build, and whether it's a foundation for what comes next.
en.answer_caption: Real interface excerpt · sample content · open evidence and sources
en.edge_visible_note: Docked at the right edge; no handle stays visible when hidden
en.edge_hidden_note: Hidden · move the pointer to the right edge to bring it back
en.f_history_body: Transcripts, answers and sources stay on your Mac. Browse by date or search.
en.cases_note: Sample documents and answers are fictional; this page calls no AI service.
en.privacy_intro: There is no LiveCopilot account and no developer relay server. Documents, indexes and session history are stored on your Mac. To answer, only the current question, relevant conversation and retrieved passages are sent to the AI provider you choose.
en.install_intro: Connect your answer service and you are ready. Add your resume or documents whenever you like.
en.ans_title:
From your own materials,
words you can say out loud.
en.ans_intro: Answers are written as words you can say, with evidence and sources. Choose how much to rely on your own documents; without any, it still answers general questions, and it can recap the conversation or suggest a follow-up.
en.style_example: Use short sentences and explain technical terms. Lead with the conclusion, then key points.
en.style_hint: Sent to your analysis service with each request.
en.pairs_zh1: 我会先上线新用户引导。
en.pairs_en1: I would ship the new onboarding flow first.
en.pairs_zh2: 它直接影响留存，也是后续功能的基础。
en.pairs_en2: It drives retention and supports later features.
en.ov_title:
There when you need it.
Otherwise, out of the way.
en.ov_intro: It docks at the right edge by default, appears when you move to the edge, and ⌥H brings it back anytime; pin it to drag it anywhere. Hiding it from screen sharing is an optional setting, off by default; test it with your meeting app first.
en.svc_title:
You choose the service
for every step.
en.svc_lead: Choose speech recognition, indexing and answers separately. What can run on your Mac can stay there; answers come from the cloud service you choose.
en.svc_speech_body: The first three recognize speech on your Mac; Apple Speech requires macOS 26+. GPT-Live-1 sends audio to OpenAI, billed by connected time. For deciding when to answer, local speech can use Laya (Apple Silicon only, downloaded separately), while GPT-Live-1 decides from meaning. Either can miss a question, and you can always generate an answer manually.
en.svc_index_body: BGE-M3 creates embeddings on your Mac. OpenAI Embeddings needs no local model, but document and query text goes to OpenAI. Either way, the retrieval database stays on your Mac.
en.svc_answer_body: Required. Bring your own API key; the provider bills you for usage. Each answer sends the question, relevant conversation and retrieved passages. More thinking usually means a longer wait.
en.tr_note: Optional and off by default. Choose Translate in the overlay and pick a target language; the translation appears under the original. It uses your answer service and counts toward its API usage.
en.custom_body: Write your preferences in Settings, such as short sentences, explained terms or conclusion first. If you answer in English, Chinese / English sentence pairs follow each Chinese sentence with its English equivalent. This shapes your answer and is separate from transcript translation.
en.service_guide_link: Service guide: models, prices and endpoints
en.privacy_boundary: Cloud speech or embedding services also receive the corresponding audio or document text, and transcript translation sends transcript text to your answer service. Each provider’s data policy applies, and deleting local history cannot retract requests already sent. Update checks read release information from this website.
en.wf_title:
From hearing the question
to a ready answer.
en.wf_intro: Three steps run in sequence. With automatic suggestions on, preparation starts as soon as the question ends; you can also ask manually at any time.
en.wf_hear: Your microphone and system audio become live text, and LiveCopilot checks whether the question is complete.
en.wf_find: Relevant passages come from the library on your Mac. Without documents, it answers directly.
en.wf_answer: The answer service you choose writes words you can say, with sources attached.
en.wf_note: Sample content. This page records nothing and calls no AI service.
en.eng_zip: Optional terminology enhancement, off by default. The model is about 200 MB and downloads on first use.
en.eng_apple: Choose one language before listening; it does not switch automatically. Uses the speech model built into macOS and requires macOS 26+.
en.eng_live_lang: Chinese-first, English-first, mixed or any language
en.eng_live: The language setting is a hint, not a lock, and the model can decide from meaning when you need an answer. Audio goes to OpenAI, billed by connected time.
en.eng_note: Local Paraformer (Chinese/English) is also available. Remote meetings label You and Them; in-person mode labels speech as Room and does not separate people in the room.
en.mode_general_body: Answers from general knowledge without your documents.
en.mode_hybrid_body: Cites your documents only when the question needs them.
en.mode_kb_body: Relies on your documents alone and says when evidence is missing.
en.eng_note_laya: Local speech can also decide when to answer with Laya, which requires Apple Silicon.
en.mode_general_answer: A common approach weighs three things: user value, cost to build, and whether it lays the groundwork for later features. Ship the one with high value and manageable cost.
en.mode_kb_answer: The product strategy puts frequent user problems first, and the roadmap places core capabilities ahead of expansion. So I would ship the most frequent need that also lays the groundwork.

zh-Hant.svc_lead: 語音識別、資料索引和回答生成分別選擇。能在本機完成的可以留在本機，回答由你選擇的雲端服務生成。
zh-Hant.svc_speech_body: 前三種在本機識別，Apple Speech 需要 macOS 26+；GPT-Live-1 會把音訊傳給 OpenAI，按連線時長計費。自動判斷何時回答：本地語音可搭配 Laya（僅 Apple Silicon，模型另行下載），GPT-Live-1 由模型按語義判斷。兩者都可能漏判，隨時可以手動生成。
zh-Hant.svc_index_body: BGE-M3 在本機產生向量；OpenAI Embeddings 無需下載本地模型，但文件和查詢文字會傳給 OpenAI。兩種方式的檢索資料庫都儲存在本機。
zh-Hant.svc_answer_body: 必須設定，需要你自己的 API Key，由服務商按用量計費。每次回答會傳送問題、相關對話和檢索片段；思考越深，通常等待越久。
zh-Hant.tr_note: 可選，預設關閉。在懸浮窗點「翻譯」選擇目標語言，譯文顯示在原文下方；翻譯使用你的回答服務，會產生 API 用量。
zh-Hant.custom_body: 在設定裡寫下偏好，例如用短句、解釋術語、先給結論。需要用英文作答時，可以開啟中英逐句對照，每句中文後緊接英文；它作用於你的回答，與翻譯對方說話的轉寫翻譯不同。
zh-Hant.service_guide_link: 服務指南：模型、價格與端點（英文）
zh-Hant.passage_found: 已找到 3 個相關片段
zh-Hant.privacy_boundary: 選擇雲端語音或向量服務時，相應的音訊或資料文字也會傳給該服務；開啟轉寫翻譯時，轉寫文字會傳給回答服務。服務商自己的資料政策仍然適用，刪除本地歷史也無法撤回已發出的請求。檢查更新時會讀取本網站上的更新資訊。
zh-Hant.privacy_keychain: API 密鑰存入 macOS 鑰匙串
zh-Hant.privacy_route_provider: 你選擇的 AI 服務
zh-Hant.wf_title:
從聽見問題，
到組織好回答。
zh-Hant.wf_intro: 三個環節依次銜接。開啟自動建議時，對方問完就開始準備回答；也可以隨時手動提問。
zh-Hant.wf_hear: 麥克風和系統音訊即時轉為文字，並判斷問題是否已經說完。
zh-Hant.wf_find: 在本機資料庫裡找回相關片段；不匯入資料也能直接回答。
zh-Hant.wf_answer: 交給你選擇的回答服務，寫成可以說出口的話，並附上來源。
zh-Hant.wf_note: 示例內容；網頁不錄音，也不呼叫 AI。
zh-Hant.eng_zip: 可選術語增強（預設關閉）。模型約 200 MB，首次使用時下載。
zh-Hant.eng_apple: 開始前選定一種語言，不會自動切換。使用 macOS 內建的語音模型，需要 macOS 26+。
zh-Hant.eng_live_lang: 中文優先、英文優先、中英混合或不限語言
zh-Hant.eng_live: 語言設定只是提示，不會強制鎖定；能按語義判斷何時需要回答。音訊傳給 OpenAI，按連線時長計費。
zh-Hant.eng_note: 另可選本地 Paraformer（中英雙語）。遠程會議分別標出「我」和「對方」；現場模式統一標為「現場」，不區分在場的不同說話人。
zh-Hant.mode_general_body: 不查資料，用通用知識回答。
zh-Hant.mode_hybrid_body: 問題需要時才引用你的資料，其餘用通用知識。
zh-Hant.mode_kb_body: 只依據你的資料；找不到依據時會說明缺口。
zh-Hant.eng_note_laya: 本地語音搭配 Laya 也能自動判斷何時回答，Laya 僅支援 Apple Silicon。
zh-Hant.mode_general_answer: 一般可以看三點：使用者價值、實現成本，以及它是不是後續功能的基礎。先上線價值高、成本可控的那一個。
zh-Hant.mode_kb_answer: 按產品策略，優先解決高頻使用者問題；路線圖也把基礎能力排在擴展之前。所以我會先上線最高頻、又能為後續打基礎的功能。
